VARN.name: VARN — Ward
VARN.cut: Once per short rest, when you take bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage, reduce it by 1d6 + your proficiency bonus.
VARN.bound: Once per short rest, reduce one instance of damage by 1d8 + proficiency bonus; until the start of your next turn you have advantage against being shoved or knocked prone.
VARN.crowned: Twice per long rest, reduce one instance of damage by 2d8 + proficiency bonus and gain resistance to that damage type until the start of your next turn.

DOR.name: DOR — Impact
DOR.cut: Once per turn for 1 minute after activation, one weapon hit deals +1d4 force damage. 1/long rest.
DOR.bound: As Cut, but +1d6 force; once during the minute you may push a Large or smaller target 10 feet after a hit (Strength save vs 8 + PB + chosen crafting ability).
DOR.crowned: As Bound, +1d8 force, and the push may affect Huge or smaller targets.

KETH.name: KETH — Binding
KETH.cut: The item cannot be casually disarmed; you have advantage on checks or saves to keep hold of it or maintain an anchor.
KETH.bound: 1/long rest after a hit or successful grapple, spectral runic bands reduce the target speed to 0 until the start of your next turn unless it succeeds on a Strength save.
KETH.crowned: 2/long rest; on a failed save the target is also restrained until the start of your next turn.

ORUN.name: ORUN — Memory
ORUN.cut: Store and replay up to one minute of spoken words or workshop sounds.
ORUN.bound: 3 charges. Spend 1 to gain advantage on one History or Investigation check concerning worked stone, crafted objects, or inscriptions you can touch. Regain 1d3 charges at dawn.
ORUN.crowned: 1/long rest, ask a worked stone or crafted object one question about a significant event it physically witnessed within the last year; the answer is an impression, not omniscient testimony.

THAR.name: THAR — Oath
THAR.cut: Choose one willing ally after a long rest. Once per short rest, add +2 AC against one attack while you are within 5 feet of that ally.
THAR.bound: The reaction becomes +3 AC and can be used within 10 feet if you can move adjacent without exceeding your speed.
THAR.crowned: 2/short rest; when the reaction causes the attack to miss, the protected ally gains temporary HP equal to your proficiency bonus.

DRATH.name: DRATH — Ember
DRATH.cut: Gain resistance to the first 10 points of fire damage you take after each long rest.
DRATH.bound: Gain fire resistance for 1 minute, 1/long rest. A weapon bearing the rune glows and can ignite unattended mundane tinder.
DRATH.crowned: Fire resistance is constant while the rune is active and attuned; 1/long rest you may become immune to fire until the start of your next turn.

ISKAR.name: ISKAR — Frost
ISKAR.cut: Ignore ordinary extreme-cold discomfort and preserve a Small object for 24 hours.
ISKAR.bound: 1/long rest when you hit, reduce the target speed by 10 feet until the end of its next turn; you also gain cold resistance for 1 minute.
ISKAR.crowned: Cold resistance is constant while active; 2/long rest reduce a hit target speed to 0 until the start of your next turn.

VAEL.name: VAEL — Passage
VAEL.cut: Gain advantage on one check per short rest to climb, squeeze through, or navigate worked stone.
VAEL.bound: 1/long rest teleport up to 30 feet between two visible spaces touching stone or masonry.
VAEL.crowned: 2/long rest teleport up to 60 feet between visible stone surfaces, bringing one willing adjacent creature.

GRUM.name: GRUM — Weight
GRUM.cut: Advantage on checks and saves against being shoved or moved while standing on stone.
GRUM.bound: 1/short rest, as a bonus action become braced until your next turn: speed 0, advantage on Strength saves, and +1 AC.
GRUM.crowned: As Bound, +2 AC, and allies directly behind you gain half cover against attacks passing through your space.

RUUN.name: RUUN — Voice
RUUN.cut: Your voice can carry clearly through 300 feet of worked tunnels without becoming painfully loud nearby.
RUUN.bound: 1/short rest issue a coordinated signal; up to PB willing allies who hear you may move 5 feet without provoking opportunity attacks.
RUUN.crowned: 2/short rest; allies may move up to 10 feet and gain advantage on the next check made to complete a shared objective before your next turn.

MOR.name: MOR — Lineage
MOR.cut: Key an item to one named willing bearer; it displays a visible warning when held by anyone else.
MOR.bound: The bearer has advantage on saves against charm effects that would force them to surrender or betray the keyed item or named ward.
MOR.crowned: 1/long rest when the bearer fails such a save, they may reroll it and must use the new result.

KHAL.name: KHAL — Forge
KHAL.cut: Repair a damaged mundane object twice as quickly and restore cosmetic damage during a short rest.
KHAL.bound: 3 charges. Spend 1 during a short rest to restore 2d8 + PB hit points to a construct or object; regain 1d3 charges at dawn.
KHAL.crowned: The repair becomes 4d8 + PB and can restore a disabled non-artifact mechanism if at least half of it remains.
